name: Kevin Liu
milestone_by_age_26: Published a first-author paper at EMNLP 2023 on truthfulness in language models while an MEng researcher at MIT CSAIL, a top-tier NLP venue.
starting_point: Undergraduate at MIT studying Mathematics and Computer Science; researcher at MIT CSAIL under Jacob Andreas and Dylan Hadfield-Menell.
current_position: Completed MEng at MIT CSAIL in 2023; researcher in AI interpretability and truthfulness in language models.

trajectory.title: Enrolled at MIT
trajectory.description: Began undergraduate studies in Mathematics and Computer Science and Engineering at MIT.

trajectory.title: Joined MIT CSAIL research group
trajectory.description: Started research at MIT CSAIL under Jacob Andreas and Dylan Hadfield-Menell, focusing on language model interpretability and truthfulness.

trajectory.title: Published first-author EMNLP paper
trajectory.description: Published 'Cognitive Dissonance: Why Do Language Model Outputs Disagree with Internal Representations of Truthfulness?' at EMNLP 2023, a top-tier NLP venue.

trajectory.title: Completed MEng thesis at MIT
trajectory.description: Submitted MEng thesis titled 'Truthfulness in Large Language Models,' exploring probing internal representations of LLMs to improve truthfulness.

trajectory.title: Graduated from MIT
trajectory.description: Received SB and MEng degrees in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from MIT in June 2023.

trajectory.title: Continued AI interpretability research
trajectory.description: Continued work on language model truthfulness and interpretability, building on the EMNLP publication and thesis findings.

name: Alexander Wang
milestone_by_age_26: Launched his eponymous fashion label in 2005 at age 21 and presented his first full women's ready-to-wear runway collection at New York Fashion Week in Fall 2007 at age 23; won the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund in 2008 at age 24.
starting_point: Born to Taiwanese American parents in San Francisco; attended Parsons School of Design in New York, leaving after two years to launch his label. Family supported the venture with brother as CFO and mother as chairwoman.
current_position: Creative director and CEO of his eponymous label Alexander Wang; stepped down from Balenciaga in 2015; remains a major figure in global fashion with over 15 stores worldwide.

trajectory.title: Moved to New York for Parsons
trajectory.description: Enrolled at Parsons School of Design at age 18 and began developing his design aesthetic in New York City.

trajectory.title: Launched eponymous label
trajectory.description: Left Parsons after two years and launched the Alexander Wang label with a predominantly knitwear collection of six unisex silhouettes.

trajectory.title: First runway show at NYFW
trajectory.description: Presented his first full women's ready-to-wear collection on the New York catwalk at New York Fashion Week in Fall 2007.

trajectory.title: Won CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund
trajectory.description: Received the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund award with $20,000 to expand the business, launching his first handbag collection the same year.

trajectory.title: Swarovski Womenswear Designer of the Year
trajectory.description: Named Swarovski Womenswear Designer of the Year at the CFDA Fashion Awards and won the Swiss Textiles Award.

trajectory.title: Opened first flagship store
trajectory.description: Opened the first Alexander Wang flagship store in Soho, New York, followed by a Beijing store in 2012.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Balenciaga
trajectory.description: Named creative director of Balenciaga in December 2012, succeeding Nicolas Ghesquiere at the storied French house.

trajectory.title: Left Balenciaga
trajectory.description: Departed from Balenciaga in July 2015 to focus on his eponymous label.

trajectory.title: Added CEO and chairman roles
trajectory.description: Took on CEO and chairman roles at his namesake brand, replacing his sister-in-law and mother in those positions.

name: Olivier Rousteing
milestone_by_age_26: Appointed creative director of Balmain in April 2011 at age 25, becoming the youngest non-founding designer to lead a major Paris house since Yves Saint Laurent and the first Black person to lead a heritage French house.
starting_point: Born in Bordeaux, France, and adopted at age one by an optician mother and seaport manager father. Dropped out of ESMOD fashion school after six months to start working at Roberto Cavalli at age 18.
current_position: Appointed creative director of Rabanne in July 2026 after stepping down from Balmain in November 2025 following a 14-year tenure.

trajectory.title: Started career at Roberto Cavalli
trajectory.description: Dropped out of ESMOD fashion school and began working at Roberto Cavalli, eventually becoming creative director of the women's ready-to-wear collection.

trajectory.title: Joined Balmain
trajectory.description: Hired by Balmain as a women's ready-to-wear designer, working closely with then-creative director Christophe Decarnin.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Balmain
trajectory.description: Replaced Christophe Decarnin as creative director of Balmain on April 26, 2011, becoming the youngest creative director in Paris since Yves Saint Laurent and the first Black person to lead a heritage French house.

trajectory.title: Balmain x H&M collaboration
trajectory.description: Launched a highly successful collaboration with H&M that achieved 99 percent sell-through, proving the heritage house's cultural relevance.

trajectory.title: Celebrated 10 years at Balmain
trajectory.description: Marked a decade as creative director with a blowout event during Paris Fashion Week featuring musical performers and a retrospective of his designs.

trajectory.title: Stepped down from Balmain
trajectory.description: Announced departure from Balmain in November 2025 after 14 years as creative director, one of fashion's longest-serving creative directors.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Rabanne
trajectory.description: Named creative director of Rabanne in July 2026, with his first collection expected for Autumn 2027.

name: Simone Rocha
milestone_by_age_26: Debuted her graduate collection at London Fashion Week and the Tate Modern in September 2010 at age 24, launching her eponymous label with immediate stocking at Dover Street Market and Colette.
starting_point: Born in Dublin, Ireland to fashion designer John Rocha and his wife Odette; worked in her father's studio from age 13 to 18 before studying at NCAD Dublin and Central Saint Martins in London.
current_position: Founder and creative director of her eponymous label with stores in London, New York, and Hong Kong; guest designer for Jean Paul Gaultier Haute Couture in 2024; British Womenswear Designer of the Year 2024.

trajectory.title: Graduated from NCAD Dublin
trajectory.description: Completed BA in Fashion at the National College of Art and Design in Dublin.

trajectory.title: Debuted at London Fashion Week and Tate Modern
trajectory.description: Showed her graduate collection from the Central Saint Martins MA at London Fashion Week and the Tate Modern, launching her eponymous label with immediate stocking at Dover Street Market and Colette.

trajectory.title: British Fashion Award: Emerging Talent
trajectory.description: Won the Emerging Talent, Ready-to-Wear award at the British Fashion Awards.

trajectory.title: The New Establishment Award
trajectory.description: Received The New Establishment Award at the British Fashion Awards and was named Young Designer of the Year by Harper's Bazaar.

trajectory.title: Opened first standalone boutique
trajectory.description: Opened her first standalone boutique on London's Mount Street in August 2015.

trajectory.title: British Womenswear Designer of the Year
trajectory.description: Won the British Womenswear Designer Award at the 2016 Fashion Awards and the Harper's Bazaar Designer of the Year Award.

trajectory.title: Creative director for Moncler Genius
trajectory.description: Presented her first collection during Milan Fashion Week as creative director for Moncler as part of the Genius Group in February 2018.

trajectory.title: H&M designer collaboration
trajectory.description: Collaborated with H&M as the Designer Collaborator for 2021, offering womens, mens, and kidswear exploring her archive.

trajectory.title: Guest designer for Jean Paul Gaultier Haute Couture
trajectory.description: Served as guest designer for Jean Paul Gaultier Haute Couture, showing in Paris in January 2024.

name: Jonathan Anderson
milestone_by_age_26: Launched the JW Anderson menswear label in 2008 at age 23 and presented his first catwalk collection at London Fashion Week in 2010 at age 25, receiving British Fashion Council NewGen sponsorship.
starting_point: Born in Magherafelt, Northern Ireland to Irish rugby international Willie Anderson and English teacher Heather Buckley; grew up during The Troubles and was diagnosed with severe dyslexia. Initially pursued acting at Juilliard before switching to fashion at London College of Fashion.
current_position: Creative director of Christian Dior (women's, men's, and haute couture) since 2025; founder of JW Anderson; named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential People in 2024.

trajectory.title: Graduated from London College of Fashion
trajectory.description: Completed a degree in menswear design at the London College of Fashion after switching from an initial pursuit of acting.

trajectory.title: Launched JW Anderson label
trajectory.description: Founded the JW Anderson menswear label, initially with a distinctive collection of accessories that garnered attention.

trajectory.title: First catwalk collection at LFW
trajectory.description: Presented his first catwalk collection at London Fashion Week with British Fashion Council NewGen sponsorship and launched a women's capsule collection.

trajectory.title: Emerging Talent at British Fashion Awards
trajectory.description: Won the Emerging Talent, Ready-to-Wear award at the British Fashion Awards.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Loewe
trajectory.description: LVMH took a minority stake in JW Anderson and appointed Anderson as creative director of Spanish luxury house Loewe in September 2013.

trajectory.title: Historic double at British Fashion Awards
trajectory.description: Won both Menswear and Womenswear Designer of the Year at the British Fashion Awards, the first time any brand won both awards in tandem.

trajectory.title: International Designer of the Year (CFDA)
trajectory.description: Named International Designer of the Year at the CFDA Awards and Designer of the Year at the Fashion Awards in London.

trajectory.title: Time 100 Most Influential People
trajectory.description: Named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential People of the year and won Designer of the Year at the Fashion Awards for the second consecutive year.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Dior
trajectory.description: Named creative director of Christian Dior for women's, men's, and haute couture collections, becoming one of the most powerful figures in global fashion.

name: Christopher Kane
milestone_by_age_26: Launched his eponymous label in 2006 at age 24 with a debut show at London Fashion Week that was lauded by international critics, and was immediately hired by Versace to work on their Atelier couture collection.
starting_point: Born as the youngest of five children in Newarthill, North Lanarkshire, Scotland to an engineer/draughtsman father and housewife mother; attended Central Saint Martins and gained attention by winning the Lancome Colour Award in 2005.
current_position: Founder and creative director of his eponymous label Christopher Kane; Kering acquired a 51 percent stake in 2013 and later sold it back to the designer.

trajectory.title: Won Lancome Colour Award
trajectory.description: Won the Lancome Colour Award while still at Central Saint Martins, attracting the attention of Donatella Versace.

trajectory.title: Launched eponymous label
trajectory.description: Established his namesake label with sister Tammy Kane as co-founder, presenting his first independent show at London Fashion Week to critical acclaim.

trajectory.title: Hired by Versace for Atelier couture
trajectory.description: Immediately hired by Versace to work on the label's Atelier couture collection and consult on shoes and accessories.

trajectory.title: Scottish Designer of the Year
trajectory.description: Named Scottish Designer of the Year for the first time and launched a capsule collection for Topshop.

trajectory.title: Creative director of Versus
trajectory.description: Appointed creative director of Versace's diffusion line Versus, instrumental in the relaunch of the label.

trajectory.title: Kering acquired majority stake
trajectory.description: Luxury group Kering acquired a 51 percent stake in the Christopher Kane label, placing the brand on the path to global recognition.

trajectory.title: BFA Designer of the Year
trajectory.description: Won Designer of the Year at the British Fashion Awards in 2013.

name: Molly Goddard
milestone_by_age_26: Showed her first collection off-schedule at London Fashion Week in September 2014 at age 25, with Dover Street Market and IT Hong Kong placing orders the next day, launching her eponymous label.
starting_point: Born in London to a graphic designer father and primary school art teacher mother; grew up in Ladbroke Grove and trained at Central Saint Martins, studying knitwear at BA and MA levels under professor Louise Wilson.
current_position: Founder and creative director of her eponymous label known for signature tulle party dresses; stocked globally at Dover Street Market, Matchesfashion, and other leading retailers.

trajectory.title: BA in Fashion Design with Knitwear from CSM
trajectory.description: Completed her BA in Fashion Design with Knitwear at Central Saint Martins.

trajectory.title: First collection at London Fashion Week
trajectory.description: Showed her first collection off-schedule at London Fashion Week in September 2014, dressing 20 friends in handmade designs; Dover Street Market and IT Hong Kong placed orders the next day.

trajectory.title: NewGen sponsorship from BFC
trajectory.description: Won sponsorship from NewGen, the British Fashion Council scheme aimed at building high-end fashion brands, and launched her first e-commerce site.

trajectory.title: Emerging Talent at Fashion Awards
trajectory.description: Awarded the Emerging Talent award at The Fashion Awards 2016 and shortlisted for the LVMH Prize 2017.

trajectory.title: Won BFC/Vogue Designer Fashion Fund
trajectory.description: Won the BFC/Vogue Designer Fashion Fund in May 2018, receiving grant and mentorship support.

trajectory.title: BFC Fashion Trust grant
trajectory.description: Received the BFC Fashion Trust grant in May 2019 to support the growth of her label.

name: Grace Wales Bonner
milestone_by_age_26: Founded the Wales Bonner label in 2014 at age 24 after graduating from Central Saint Martins, debuted the 'Ebonics' collection at Fashion East in London in 2015, and won the LVMH Young Designer Prize in 2016 at age 25-26.
starting_point: Born in South London to a White English mother and Black Jamaican father; raised between Dulwich and Stockwell after parents' separation. Graduated from Central Saint Martins in 2014 with the L'Oreal Professionnel Talent Award.
current_position: Founder of Wales Bonner; appointed creative director of Hermes menswear in 2025, succeeding Veronique Nichanian; MBE for services to fashion.

trajectory.title: Founded Wales Bonner label
trajectory.description: Founded the London-based label Wales Bonner after graduating from Central Saint Martins, winning the L'Oreal Professionnel Talent Award for her BA collection 'Afrique'.

trajectory.title: Debuted 'Ebonics' at Fashion East
trajectory.description: Debuted the 'Ebonics' Autumn/Winter 2015 collection with Fashion East at London Collections: Men and won Emerging Menswear Designer at the British Fashion Awards.

trajectory.title: Won LVMH Young Designer Prize
trajectory.description: Received the LVMH Prize for Young Fashion Designers, comprising 300,000 euros and a year-long mentorship from LVMH executives.

trajectory.title: Won BFC/Vogue Designer Fashion Fund
trajectory.description: Won the British Fashion Council/Vogue Designer Fashion Fund, supporting the growth of her label.

trajectory.title: Launched Adidas Originals collaboration
trajectory.description: Began a collaboration with Adidas Originals that would later revitalize the Samba sneaker and become widely influential in footwear fashion.

trajectory.title: CFDA International Men's Designer of the Year
trajectory.description: Named CFDA International Men's Designer of the Year, cementing her global influence in menswear.

trajectory.title: Appointed MBE
trajectory.description: Appointed Member of the Order of the British Empire (MBE) in June 2022 for services to fashion.

trajectory.title: Appointed creative director of Hermes menswear
trajectory.description: Named creative director of Hermes menswear, succeeding Veronique Nichanian after 37 years, becoming the first woman of Black heritage to lead a major luxury fashion house.

name: Tyler Mitchell
milestone_by_age_26: Shot the cover of American Vogue's September 2018 issue featuring Beyonce at age 23, becoming the first African American photographer to shoot a Vogue cover; Smithsonian National Portrait Gallery acquired one of the portraits in 2019.
starting_point: Born in Atlanta, Georgia; grew up in Marietta. Purchased a Canon camera in ninth grade and taught himself skateboarding videography, inspired by Spike Jonze. Attended NYU Tisch School of the Arts for cinematography.
current_position: Brooklyn-based photographer and filmmaker working with major fashion brands including Marc Jacobs, Givenchy, Converse, Nike, and Loewe; represented by Jack Shainman Gallery.

trajectory.title: Published first book 'El Paquete'
trajectory.description: Self-published a 108-page book documenting skateboarding life and architecture in Havana, Cuba, after a six-week photography program.

trajectory.title: Graduated from NYU Tisch
trajectory.description: Completed BFA in cinematography at NYU Tisch School of the Arts, studying with Deborah Willis.

trajectory.title: Shot Beyonce for Vogue September cover
trajectory.description: Photographed Beyonce for the cover of American Vogue's September 2018 issue, becoming the first African American photographer to shoot a Vogue cover.

trajectory.title: Smithsonian acquired portrait
trajectory.description: The Smithsonian National Portrait Gallery acquired one of the Beyonce portraits by Mitchell for their permanent collection.

trajectory.title: Second Vogue cover and major campaigns
trajectory.description: Racked up a second Vogue cover and shot campaigns for JW Anderson, Calvin Klein, Marc Jacobs, and Givenchy.

trajectory.title: Shot Time cover of Edward Enninful
trajectory.description: Photographed Edward Enninful, editor-in-chief of British Vogue, for the cover of Time magazine.

name: Nadine Ijewere
milestone_by_age_26: Became the first woman of colour to shoot a cover for any Vogue edition worldwide with her January 2019 British Vogue cover featuring Dua Lipa, Binx Walton, and Letitia Wright at age 26.
starting_point: Born in London to a Nigerian father and Jamaican mother; grew up in Peckham, South London. Initially studied science and maths at A-level before switching to photography at the London College of Fashion.
current_position: London-based photographer working with Dior, Hermes, Stella McCartney, Nina Ricci, Valentino, and major publications including Vogue, WSJ Magazine, and Dazed; published first monograph with Prestel.

trajectory.title: Graduated from London College of Fashion
trajectory.description: Completed photography degree at the London College of Fashion, having started casting mixed-race models outside the industry norm during her final year.

trajectory.title: Built reputation via social media
trajectory.description: Worked at an interior design company while building her photography reputation on social media, casting mixed-race friends and posting her work online.

trajectory.title: Exhibited at Unseen and Lagos Photo Festival
trajectory.description: Her work featured at the Unseen photography fair and the Lagos Photo Festival, gaining industry recognition.

trajectory.title: First woman of colour to shoot Vogue cover
trajectory.description: Shot the January 2019 British Vogue cover featuring Dua Lipa, Binx Walton, and Letitia Wright, becoming the first woman of colour to shoot a cover for any Vogue edition in the magazine's 125-year history.

trajectory.title: ICP Infinity Award
trajectory.description: Received the 2020 Infinity Award for Applied Photography from the International Center of Photography.

trajectory.title: Published first monograph
trajectory.description: Published her first monograph with Prestel, collating over 160 photographs from her career focusing on women of colour.

name: Petra Collins
milestone_by_age_26: Opened her first solo exhibition 'Discharge' at Capricious 88 Gallery in New York in February 2014 at age 21, cementing her position as a leading voice in feminist photography and the 'female gaze' movement.
starting_point: Born in Toronto, Canada to a Hungarian refugee mother and Canadian father; attended Rosedale Heights School of the Arts and OCAD University for two years before dropping out and moving to New York with a suitcase of negatives.
current_position: Toronto and New York-based artist, photographer, and filmmaker; directed music videos for Olivia Rodrigo, Cardi B, and Selena Gomez; working on narrative feature debut.

trajectory.title: Began photography at Rosedale Heights
trajectory.description: Started practicing photography at age 15 at Rosedale Heights School of the Arts in Toronto after a knee injury ended her dance career.

trajectory.title: Resident photographer for Rookie magazine
trajectory.description: Became a resident photographer for Tavi Gevinson's Rookie magazine, gaining early recognition for her dreamy feminine aesthetic on Tumblr.

trajectory.title: First solo exhibition 'Discharge'
trajectory.description: Opened her first solo exhibition 'Discharge' at Capricious 88 Gallery in New York in February 2014, cementing her position as a leading voice in feminist photography.

trajectory.title: Chosen as face of Gucci
trajectory.description: Selected as a face of Gucci in 2016, solidifying her status in the fashion world alongside her art photography career.

trajectory.title: Directed Olivia Rodrigo 'good 4 u' video
trajectory.description: Directed the music video for Olivia Rodrigo's hit single 'good 4 u,' beginning a prolific collaboration with the pop star.

trajectory.title: VMA nomination for 'vampire'
trajectory.description: Directed Olivia Rodrigo's 'vampire' music video, which was nominated for Video of the Year at the MTV VMAs.

name: Jadé Fadojutimi
milestone_by_age_26: Had her first solo exhibition 'Heliophobia' at Pippy Houldsworth Gallery in London in December 2017 at age 24, with immediate representation and acquisitions by Tate, ICA Miami, and Dallas Museum of Art following.
starting_point: Born in London in 1993 to British-Nigerian parents; father a management consultant, mother a civil servant. Grew up in Ilford as the eldest of three daughters. Studied at Slade School of Fine Art and Royal College of Art.
current_position: London-based painter represented by Gagosian; included in TIME 100 Next list of most influential rising leaders in 2024; works in collections of Tate, LACMA, Hammer Museum, Stedelijk Museum, and others.

trajectory.title: Graduated from Slade School of Fine Art
trajectory.description: Completed BA from the Slade School of Fine Art in London.

trajectory.title: First solo exhibition 'Heliophobia'
trajectory.description: Had her first solo exhibition 'Heliophobia' at Pippy Houldsworth Gallery in London in December 2017, with immediate representation and acquisitions by Tate, ICA Miami, and Dallas Museum of Art.

trajectory.title: MA from Royal College of Art
trajectory.description: Earned an MA from the Royal College of Art, London, receiving the Hine Painting Prize the same year.

trajectory.title: First institutional solo show at PEER UK
trajectory.description: Had her first one-person institutional show 'The Numbing Vibrancy of Characters in Play' at PEER UK, London.

trajectory.title: First US museum solo at ICA Miami
trajectory.description: Opened her first US museum solo exhibition 'Yet, Another Pathetic Fallacy' at the Institute of Contemporary Art, Miami in November 2021.

trajectory.title: Venice Biennale participation
trajectory.description: Selected to participate in the 59th Venice Biennale, 'The Milk of Dreams,' a major milestone in her career.

trajectory.title: TIME 100 Next list
trajectory.description: Included in the TIME 100 Next list of the world's most influential rising leaders in October 2024.

name: FEWOCiOUS (Victor Langlois)
milestone_by_age_26: Sold his NFT artwork 'Hello, i'm Victor (FEWOCiOUS) and This Is My Life' at Christie's in June 2021 for $2.16 million at age 18, becoming the youngest artist to have a solo sale at Christie's.
starting_point: Born in Las Vegas, Nevada; raised by his grandmother who moved from El Salvador. Began creating art at age 13 as a refuge from an abusive household. Sold his first painting for $90 in 2020 at age 17.
current_position: Seattle and New York-based digital artist with nearly $50 million in lifetime NFT sales; continues to build the FewoWorld digital universe.

trajectory.title: Sold first painting
trajectory.description: Sold his first painting to a New York art collector for $90 in March 2020, beginning his career in digital art.

trajectory.title: Gained following on SuperRare and Nifty Gateway
trajectory.description: Gained a following selling artwork on online NFT platforms SuperRare and Nifty Gateway.

trajectory.title: Christie's solo sale for $2.16 million
trajectory.description: Sold 'Hello, i'm Victor (FEWOCiOUS) and This Is My Life' at Christie's in June 2021 for $2.16 million, becoming the youngest artist to have a solo sale at Christie's.

trajectory.title: RTFKT sneaker collaboration
trajectory.description: Collaborated with Nike subsidiary RTFKT on an NFT sneaker collection that sold over $3.1 million in seven minutes.

trajectory.title: Paint Drop collection sold $20 million
trajectory.description: Sold his Paint Drop NFT collection through Nifty Gateway for $20 million in 24 hours, the third-highest sale in Nifty Gateway history.

trajectory.title: Billboard magazine redesign
trajectory.description: Redesigned the logo and cover of Billboard magazine for its annual Pride Issue in June 2022.

name: Diana Sinclair
milestone_by_age_26: Headlined the inaugural sale on Christie's 3.0 NFT platform in September 2022 at age 18 with a solo exhibition 'Phases' at Christie's New York galleries, and previously collaborated with the Whitney Houston estate on an NFT that sold for $1 million in November 2021 at age 17.
starting_point: Born in 2004 in New Jersey; raised in an artistic and tech-savvy household with a writer mother and artist/software developer father. Started drawing on an iPad as a child and was introduced to photography at SVA's summer intensive in 2019.
current_position: New Jersey-based interdisciplinary artist and researcher examining Black identity, water, and memory through lens-based media; completed residency at Silver Art Projects at the World Trade Center.

trajectory.title: Introduced to photography at SVA
trajectory.description: Attended SVA's summer intensive on a scholarship, where she was first introduced to a camera and transitioned to photo and video work.

trajectory.title: Whitney Houston estate NFT collaboration
trajectory.description: Collaborated with the Whitney Houston estate on an NFT featuring never-before-seen video of the singer, which sold for $1 million in November 2021.

trajectory.title: Named to Fortune's 50 Most Influential in NFTs
trajectory.description: Selected by Fortune as one of the 50 most influential figures in the NFT space.

trajectory.title: Inaugural Christie's 3.0 sale
trajectory.description: Headlined the inaugural sale on Christie's 3.0 NFT platform with solo exhibition 'Phases' at Christie's New York galleries in September 2022.

trajectory.title: Gemma Projects Inaugural Curatorial Grant
trajectory.description: Received the Gemma Projects Inaugural Curatorial Grant in 2023.

trajectory.title: Rockefeller Center public installation
trajectory.description: Her public installation 'Reflections' was on view at Rockefeller Center from 2023 to 2024.

trajectory.title: Silver Art Projects residency
trajectory.description: Completed a year-long residency at the World Trade Center with Silver Art Projects.

name: Richard Quinn
milestone_by_age_26: Won the H&M Design Award 2017 in November 2016 at age 26, receiving €50,000 and a year-long mentorship, and established his eponymous label in 2016 after graduating from the Central Saint Martins MA course.
starting_point: Born in Lewisham, raised in Eltham, South East London; youngest of five children to parents Eileen and Patrick Quinn. Studied BA Fashion Print at Central Saint Martins, graduating in 2014, then MA Fashion with the Stella McCartney Scholarship.
current_position: Founder and creative director of Richard Quinn Ltd in London, known for bold floral prints and maximalist couture-like designs; clients include Amal Clooney, Lady Gaga, and Jennifer Lopez.

trajectory.title: Graduated BA from Central Saint Martins
trajectory.description: Completed BA Fashion Print at Central Saint Martins, with his collection picked up by Stella McCartney.

trajectory.title: Won H&M Design Award
trajectory.description: Won the H&M Design Award in November 2016, receiving 50,000 euros and a year-long mentorship, with pieces sold in selected H&M stores.

trajectory.title: Established eponymous label
trajectory.description: Founded Richard Quinn Ltd after graduating from the Central Saint Martins MA Fashion course with the Stella McCartney Scholarship.

trajectory.title: Named BFC NEWGEN one-to-watch
trajectory.description: Named as the British Fashion Council's NEWGEN one-to-watch and awarded exhibition space in the LFW Designer Showrooms in April 2017.

trajectory.title: Queen Elizabeth II attended his LFW show
trajectory.description: Queen Elizabeth II attended his Autumn/Winter 2018 runway show at London Fashion Week and presented him with the inaugural Queen Elizabeth II Award for British Design.

trajectory.title: Amal Clooney wore Quinn to Met Gala
trajectory.description: Amal Clooney chose a Richard Quinn design for the Met Gala in May 2018, bringing Quinn to international attention.

name: Campbell Addy
milestone_by_age_26: Held his debut solo exhibition 'Matthew 7:7 & 8' at KK Outlet in London in 2017 at age 24, and founded Nii Journal and Nii Agency in 2016 while still at Central Saint Martins, establishing himself as a photographer and publisher.
starting_point: Born in South London to British-Ghanaian parents; left home at 16 to pursue photography. Discovered photography books by Nick Knight and Irving Penn while sorting a school library in detention. Studied Fashion Communications at Central Saint Martins.
current_position: British-Ghanaian photographer and artist; published monograph 'Feeling Seen' in 2022; won Isabella Blow Award for Fashion Creator at the British Fashion Awards 2023; RPS Award for Fashion Photography 2024.

trajectory.title: Founded Nii Journal and Nii Agency
trajectory.description: Launched Nii Journal, a biannual art and culture publication, and Nii Agency, a modelling and casting company dedicated to diversity, during his final year at Central Saint Martins.

trajectory.title: Debut solo exhibition
trajectory.description: Held his debut solo exhibition 'Matthew 7:7 & 8' at KK Outlet in London in 2017.

trajectory.title: British Fashion Awards: New Wave Creative
trajectory.description: Recognized at the British Fashion Awards with the New Wave Creative award in 2018 and again in 2019.

trajectory.title: Shot Edward Enninful for Time cover
trajectory.description: Photographed Edward Enninful, editor-in-chief of British Vogue, for the cover of Time magazine.

trajectory.title: Forbes 30 Under 30
trajectory.description: Named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list in 2021 for his photography and publishing work.

trajectory.title: Published first monograph 'Feeling Seen'
trajectory.description: Published his first monograph 'Feeling Seen: The Photographs of Campbell Addy' to critical acclaim.

trajectory.title: Isabella Blow Award for Fashion Creator
trajectory.description: Awarded the Isabella Blow Award for Fashion Creator by the British Fashion Council in 2023.

name: Amit Elor

starting_point: Born in Montpellier, France to a table tennis family; father Stephane was ranked as high as #7 in France and uncle Christophe Legout represented France at three Olympic Games. Introduced to table tennis at age three and trained by his father at the Montpellier pôle espoir.
current_position: French national table tennis champion; world #4 ranked player and top-ranked European; first French player to win a WTT Champions tournament; world's top-ranked doubles player with brother Alexis.

trajectory.title: European Championships doubles bronze
trajectory.description: Reached the men's doubles semi-finals at the European Championships with brother Alexis, earning his first continental bronze medal, and won the French doubles championship.

trajectory.title: European Games gold
trajectory.description: Won his first individual title at the European Games in Krakow, defeating Portugal's Marcos Freitas in the final, and entered the world's top 10 at age 17.

trajectory.title: Two Olympic bronze medals at Paris 2024
trajectory.description: Won bronze in individual singles and team events at the Paris 2024 Olympics at age 17, becoming the youngest-ever male medalist in Olympic table tennis.

trajectory.title: First French WTT Champions winner
trajectory.description: Became the first French player to win a WTT Champions tournament in Montpellier in October 2024.

trajectory.title: World #1 in doubles with brother Alexis
trajectory.description: Became the world's top-ranked doubles player alongside his elder brother Alexis Lebrun by November 2024 after winning the European doubles championship and WTT Finals.

trajectory.title: French national champion
trajectory.description: Became the French national table tennis champion in March 2025 by defeating his brother Alexis in the final.

current_position: Striker for FC Copenhagen, having transferred from Borussia Dortmund in July 2025 after a loan spell at OGC Nice.

trajectory.title: Joined Borussia Dortmund youth academy
trajectory.description: Transferred from FC St. Pauli to Borussia Dortmund's youth academy in July 2016.

trajectory.title: U17 German Championship winner

trajectory.title: Youngest Bundesliga player ever
trajectory.description: Made his Bundesliga debut for Borussia Dortmund on November 21, 2020 at age 16 years and one day, becoming the youngest player in Bundesliga history.

trajectory.title: Youngest Bundesliga scorer and Champions League player
trajectory.description: Became the Bundesliga's youngest scorer 27 days after his debut and the youngest-ever UEFA Champions League player in December 2020.

trajectory.title: DFB-Pokal and UEFA U21 Euro winner
trajectory.description: Won the DFB-Pokal (German Cup) with Borussia Dortmund and the UEFA U21 European Championship with Germany in 2021.

trajectory.title: Loan to OGC Nice

trajectory.title: Transferred to FC Copenhagen
trajectory.description: Left Borussia Dortmund and joined Danish champions FC Copenhagen in July 2025 on a contract until 2030.

name: Finneas O'Connell
milestone_by_age_26: Won five Grammy Awards at the 62nd Grammy Awards on January 26, 2020, at age 22, including Producer of the Year, Non-Classical (the youngest winner in Grammy history), Best Engineered Album, and shared Album/Record/Song of the Year for producing Billie Eilish's debut album.
starting_point: Born in Los Angeles to actress/screenwriter Maggie Baird and actor Patrick O'Connell; sister of Billie Eilish. Started writing and recording music around age 12 and was a child actor, appearing in Bad Teacher (2011) and Glee (2015).
current_position: Eleven-time Grammy winner and two-time Academy Award winner; one of the most sought-after producers in music; released second solo album 'For Cryin' Out Loud!' in 2024.

trajectory.title: Film debut in Bad Teacher
trajectory.description: Made his film debut alongside Cameron Diaz in Bad Teacher, beginning his career as a child actor.

trajectory.title: Recurring role on Glee

trajectory.title: Produced Billie Eilish's 'Ocean Eyes'
trajectory.description: Produced his sister Billie Eilish's breakthrough single 'Ocean Eyes,' a song he had originally written for his band, which garnered tens of millions of streams.

name: Charli D'Amelio
milestone_by_age_26: Became the first TikTok creator to reach 100 million followers in November 2020 at age 16, and was the most-followed creator on the platform from March 2020 to June 2022, earning an estimated $70 million in two years per Forbes.
starting_point: Born in Norwalk, Connecticut to photographer and former model Heidi D'Amelio and business owner Marc D'Amelio. Began dancing at age three and was a competitive dancer for over 10 years before starting her TikTok career in 2019.
current_position: Social media superstar with over 158 million TikTok followers; Broadway performer in '& Juliet'; Prada ambassador; co-founder of D'Amelio Brands; earned over $70 million since 2020.

trajectory.title: Started posting on TikTok

trajectory.description: Gained widespread exposure in October 2019 for performing the 'Renegade' dance to K Camp's 'Lottery,' credited with popularizing the dance on social media.

trajectory.title: First TikTok creator to reach 100 million followers

trajectory.title: Broadway debut in '& Juliet'

name: Shayne Coplan
milestone_by_age_26: Founded Polymarket in June 2020 at age 22, building a blockchain-based prediction market that became one of the world's largest prediction platforms, and became the world's youngest self-made billionaire at age 27 in 2025.
starting_point: Born in 1998 and raised on the Upper West Side of Manhattan by his mother. Participated in Ethereum's 2014 ICO at age 15, acquiring ETH at around $0.30 per token. Attended NYU for computer science but dropped out during freshman year.
current_position: Founder and CEO of Polymarket; world's youngest self-made billionaire with estimated net worth of $1 billion as of October 2025; Polymarket valued at $9 billion after Intercontinental Exchange investment.

trajectory.title: Participated in Ethereum ICO
trajectory.description: Acquired Ethereum during its initial coin offering at around $0.30 per token, introducing him to cryptocurrency and providing seed funding for future ventures.

trajectory.title: Created TokenUnion
trajectory.description: Built TokenUnion, a crypto loyalty program rewarding users for holding specific tokens, as his first crypto-based project.

trajectory.title: Founded Polymarket
trajectory.description: Founded Polymarket in June 2020, pivoting from a DeFi project to focus entirely on prediction markets during the COVID-19 pandemic, working alone from his Lower East Side apartment.

trajectory.title: Polymarket gained mainstream attention
trajectory.description: Polymarket gained widespread attention during the 2024 US presidential election as a leading prediction platform for real-world events.

trajectory.title: Became world's youngest self-made billionaire
trajectory.description: Intercontinental Exchange invested $2 billion in Polymarket at a $9 billion valuation in October 2025, making Coplan the world's youngest self-made billionaire with an estimated 11% stake.

name: Laura Deming
milestone_by_age_26: Founded The Longevity Fund in 2011 at age 17, the first venture capital firm dedicated to funding aging and life-extension biotech companies, after being named a Thiel Fellow and dropping out of MIT at age 14.
starting_point: Born in 1994 and grew up in New Zealand; homeschooled by parents John and Tabitha Deming. Became interested in the biology of aging at age 8, joined Cynthia Kenyon's lab at UCSF at age 12, and was accepted to MIT at age 14.
current_position: Partner at The Longevity Fund and founder of AGE1 accelerator; raised $27 million across two funds for longevity-focused investments; Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree.

trajectory.title: Joined Cynthia Kenyon's lab at UCSF
trajectory.description: Moved from New Zealand to the US to join the lab of renowned aging researcher Cynthia Kenyon at UCSF after writing to her at age 11.

trajectory.title: Accepted to MIT
trajectory.description: Accepted to MIT at age 14 to study physics, while continuing to work in labs including Lenny Guarente's.

trajectory.title: Named Thiel Fellow and dropped out of MIT
trajectory.description: Accepted into the Thiel Fellowship program, receiving $100,000 to build new things, and dropped out of MIT to start a venture capital firm focused on aging.

trajectory.title: Founded The Longevity Fund
trajectory.description: Founded The Longevity Fund, the first VC firm dedicated to funding aging and life-extension biotech companies, raising $4 million in its first fund.

trajectory.title: Closed second fund with $22 million
trajectory.description: Closed the second Longevity Fund with $22 million, backing companies including Unity Biotechnology, Precision Biosciences, and Metacrine.

trajectory.title: Launched AGE1 accelerator
trajectory.description: Launched the AGE1 accelerator, a four-month startup program aimed at supporting founders developing longevity-focused companies.

name: Gukesh Dommaraju
milestone_by_age_26: Won the FIDE World Chess Championship in December 2024 at age 18, defeating Ding Liren to become the youngest undisputed world chess champion in history.
starting_point: Born in Chennai, India to a Telugu family; mother is a microbiologist and father is an ENT surgeon. Started playing chess at age seven at school and quit school to focus on chess, with his father leaving his job to travel with him.
current_position: Reigning FIDE World Chess Champion; peak rating of 2794; youngest undisputed world chess champion in history at 18 years and 195 days.

trajectory.title: Won Under-9 Asian School Chess Championships
trajectory.description: Won the under-9 section of the Asian School Chess Championships and earned the Candidate Master title.

trajectory.title: Became International Master
trajectory.description: Became an International Master in March 2018 at age 11 and won the Under-12 World Youth Chess Championship.

trajectory.title: Became Grandmaster
trajectory.description: Earned the Grandmaster title on January 15, 2019 at age 12 years, 7 months, and 17 days, becoming the second-youngest grandmaster in history at the time.

trajectory.title: Olympiad individual gold and crossed 2700 Elo
trajectory.description: Won individual gold at the 44th Chess Olympiad and crossed the 2700 Elo mark, becoming the third-youngest to achieve super-Grandmaster level.

trajectory.title: Became top-rated Indian player
trajectory.description: Became the top-rated Indian player in the September 2023 rating list, ending Viswanathan Anand's 37-year reign, and became the youngest player to surpass 2750 Elo.

trajectory.title: Won Candidates Tournament
trajectory.description: Won the 2024 FIDE Candidates Tournament with a score of 9/14, becoming the youngest-ever Candidates Tournament winner.

trajectory.title: Won World Chess Championship
trajectory.description: Defeated Ding Liren in the FIDE World Chess Championship in December 2024, becoming the 18th and youngest undisputed world chess champion in history at 18 years and 195 days.
